inheritance_note_template: Uses the template {{product}}. Empty fields show what it inherits from there.
inheritance_note_parent: A variant of {{product}}. Empty fields show what it inherits from there.

general.label: General
general.organization_note: Item categories set tax and shipping; collections organize the catalog.

kind.label: Kind
kind.helper_text: A template holds details shared by products that aren't variants of each other. It's never sold or listed in the catalog.

price.label: Price
price.help: A price or list price set here replaces all the pricing this product would inherit.

list-price.label: List price
list-price.help: The higher price it used to sell for, shown struck through beside the price.

dialog.search: Find a collection by name or path

hidden.label: Hidden from the catalog
hidden.helper_text: Hidden products are left out of the catalog's lists and collections, and a hidden variant isn't offered on its parent's page. They're still public: anyone with the SKU can load one, the storefront elements show it, and it can be bought. Less visible, not invisible.

brand.label: Brand
brand.help: The maker or label. The storefront elements show it by the product's name and in a product page's details, and pass it to search engines and to your analytics.

gtin.label: GTIN
gtin.help: The number under the barcode: a UPC, EAN, ISBN or GTIN-14. A product page lists it in its details and gives it to search engines, which use it to match the product to shopping listings.

mpn.label: MPN
mpn.help: The maker's own part number, for a product without a GTIN. A product page lists it in its details and gives it to search engines, which use it with the brand to match the product.

dialog.search: Find a category by name or code

option-values.label: Option values
option-values.helper_text: Which combination of its parent's options this variant is. Each variant needs a value for every option, and no two variants can share a combination.

description.label: Description
description.placeholder: What it is, what it’s made of, how to use it.
description.helper_text: Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, lists, links and headings. Shown on product pages.

description-preview.label: Preview
description-preview.helper_text: The description as your product page shows it, in your store's look, with your unsaved changes. Auto makes tabs or an accordion of three or more headings. Description sections changes only this preview: your site uses what its product page snippet sets.

images.label: Images
images.by_url: Add an image by its URL
images.url_invalid: Enter an https URL, such as https://example.com/tee.jpg.
images.save_first: Save the product to upload images, or add one by its URL.
images.inherited: Uses {{count}} image(s) from the product it inherits from. Add images here to replace them.
images.alt_helper_text: Describe the image for people who can’t see it, such as “Black tee, front, on a hanger”.
images.main: Main image, shown in the cart
images.error_upload: Couldn’t upload {{file}}. Try again, or use a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP.
images.drag: Drag onto another image to reorder
images.error_too_large: {{file}} is too large. Images can be at most 10 MB.

properties.label: Properties
properties.helper_text: Facts about the product for its page and catalog filters, such as Material: Organic cotton. They aren't added to the cart or the order. A choice the shopper makes is an option or a modifier.
properties.v8n_too_long: Too many properties to save. Remove some.

options.label: Options
options.limit_reached: A product can have up to 3 options.
options.name_helper_text: What a form sends, such as color. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
options.option_label_helper_text: What the shopper sees. The name if blank.
options.values_helper_text: The value is what a form sends and the order records. The label is what the shopper sees, and the SKU part goes into generated SKUs; both use the value if blank.
options.price_mod_helper_text: Added to a variant's price unless the variant sets its own. Store currency; can be negative.
options.weight_mod_helper_text: Added to a variant's weight unless it sets its own.
options.image_url_invalid: Enter an https URL, such as https://example.com/swatch.png.
options.image_save_first: Save the product to upload images, or use an image URL.
options.image_error_upload: Couldn’t upload that file. Try again, or use a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP.
options.v8n_too_many: A product can have up to 3 options. Remove one.
options.v8n_name_invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, such as gift_wrap.
options.v8n_name_reserved: Foxy's cart already uses this name, or it starts with a digit. Choose another.
options.v8n_name_duplicate: Another one already has this name.
options.v8n_value_duplicate: Another value is the same (ignoring case).
options.v8n_amount_invalid: Enter a number, such as 2.50 or -1.
options.v8n_name_used_by_modifier: A modifier already has this name.
options.v8n_sku_code_invalid: Letters and digits only, up to 20.
options.v8n_image_invalid: Must be an https URL. Upload the image again.
options.has_variants: This product has variants, so it can't gain an option: they would have no value for it. You can still add values.
options.removed_values: Removed: {{values}}. Variants that use it are deleted when you save.
options.removed_values_plural: Removed: {{values}}. Variants that use them are deleted when you save.
options.removed_used: Removed. {{count}} variant is deleted when you save.
options.removed_used_plural: Removed. {{count}} variants are deleted when you save.
options.image_error_too_large: That file is too large. Images can be at most 10 MB.

modifiers.stale_removal: Removes {{name}}, which isn't inherited. It does nothing.
modifiers.name_helper_text: What a form sends, such as gift_wrap. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
modifiers.modifier_label_helper_text: What the shopper sees. The name if blank.
modifiers.required_label: Required: the shopper must fill it in
modifiers.values_helper_text: The value is what a form sends and the order records. The label is what the shopper sees; the value if blank.
modifiers.price_mod_helper_text: Added to the item's price when chosen. Store currency; can be negative.
modifiers.text_price_mod_helper_text: Added to the item's price when the shopper enters anything. Store currency.
modifiers.category_code_helper_text: Optional. Replaces the item's category, so tax and shipping follow it.
modifiers.v8n_too_many: A product can have up to 25 modifiers, inherited ones included.
modifiers.v8n_name_invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, such as gift_wrap.
modifiers.v8n_name_reserved: Foxy's cart already uses this name, or it starts with a digit. Choose another.
modifiers.v8n_name_duplicate: Another one already has this name.
modifiers.v8n_value_duplicate: Another value is the same (ignoring case).
modifiers.v8n_amount_invalid: Enter a number, such as 2.50 or -1.
modifiers.v8n_name_used_by_option: An option already has this name.

stock-level.label: Stock level
stock-level.placeholder: Leave blank to skip stock tracking
stock-level.helper_text: 0 = out of stock. Blank = not tracked.

stock-level-template.label: Starting stock
stock-level-template.placeholder: Leave blank for products that don't track stock
stock-level-template.helper_text: Each product made from this template starts with this many. Nothing draws on the template's own stock.

low-stock-threshold.label: Low-stock alert at
low-stock-threshold.helper_text: This product counts as low at this many or fewer. Blank uses the number it inherits or your store's, shown here. 0 means it's never low.

stock-rules.label: Stock rules
stock-rules.helper_text: Other stock this product takes when it's bought, such as a full pass taking a place on each day. Its own stock level, if it has one, still counts.
stock-rules.delete_message: Purchases will stop drawing on that product's stock.

dialog.undo_message: You haven’t saved your changes. What would you like to do with them?

target.label: Takes stock from
target.helper_text: The product whose stock goes down when this one is bought. A template can't be chosen.

multiplier.label: Units per purchase
multiplier.helper_text: Units taken from the target product for each one bought. 0 counts against nothing.
multiplier.v8n_invalid: Must be a whole number, 0 or more.

delete.delete_prompt: Delete this stock rule? Rules can't be changed, so delete one and create it again to change it.

tags.label: Tags
tags.helper_text: Free-form labels for filtering and search.
tags.delete_message: Remove this tag from the product?

dialog.undo_message: You haven’t saved your changes. What would you like to do with them?

generate-variants.pattern_helper_text: Optional. {parent} is this product's SKU; {name} is an option value's SKU code. Default {{- pattern}}, giving {{- example}}.
generate-variants.missing: {{count}} combination doesn't have a variant yet.
generate-variants.missing_plural: {{count}} combinations don't have a variant yet.

variants.label: Variants
variants.empty: No variants yet. Create them from the options above, or add one.
variants.empty_no_options: Variants come from options. Add an option, save, then create its variants.
variants.created: Created {{count}} variant. It inherits its price and settings from this product until you change them.
variants.created_plural: Created {{count}} variants. They inherit their price and settings from this product until you change them.
variants.created_none: Every combination already has a variant.
variants.v8n_invalid: Some variants have values that can't be saved. Fix the fields marked in red, then save.
variants.v8n_price: A number, 0 or more, such as 24.95.
variants.save_failed: Couldn't save {{sku}}; the changes after it weren't saved either.
variants.panel_name_help: Leave blank to use the product's name.
variants.panel_description_help: Markdown. Leave blank to use the product's description.
variants.panel_price_help: Leave blank to use the product's price.
variants.confirm_message: These variants are deleted when you save, because an option or value they use was removed here or you chose to delete them. Their stock and settings go with them; past orders keep them. A variant created later for the same combination starts fresh.

template-products.label: Products using this template
template-products.helper_text: Products that inherit from this template. Changing the template changes them.

delete.delete_prompt: Soft-delete this product? Restorable later by clearing deleted_at.

general.title: General
general.description: Name, SKU, price, images and whether the catalog lists it. Variants inherit these unless they set their own.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: How many you have, and when that counts as low. Change many products at once in Inventory.
inventory.variants_note: Each variant holds its own stock: change the counts in the variants table under Options and variants. A number here is stock the product itself holds, which variants without their own draw on.

options.title: Options and variants
options.description: Options make variants. Each combination of values is a variant with its own SKU, price and stock. Up to 3 options and 250 variants.

modifiers.title: Modifiers
modifiers.description: What the shopper picks or types when adding to the cart, such as a gift message. Can be required and can add to the price or weight. The SKU stays the same. Up to 25.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: Fixed facts shown to shoppers, such as material or fit, and tags. Shoppers never choose them.

storefront.title: Storefront elements
storefront.description: Code for your site, or a link for email and social posts, that adds this product to the cart.

variant-dialog.undo_message: You haven’t saved your changes. What would you like to do with them?

storefront.hint_link: A plain URL for emails, texts and social posts. It adds one SKU to the cart.
storefront.hint_button: One button on your site that adds one SKU.
storefront.hint_form: Options, modifiers, quantity and the button.
storefront.hint_tile: Photo, name, price and button, for a grid.
storefront.hint_page: Everything about this product on one page.
storefront.pick_variant: Choose a variant: the cart can't ask the shopper for options, so a link or a button adds one variant.
storefront.no_variants: This product has options but no variants yet. Create its variants, then come back for a link.

cart-link-builder.label: Add-to-cart link
cart-link-builder.helper_text: Make the shopper's choices to get a link that adds this product with them. Uses the saved product.
cart-link-builder.incomplete: Choose a value for every option and fill in every required modifier to see the link.
